scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting: pnpm run firebase:build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.firebase:deploy:functions: cd functions && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting:render: pnpm --filter @workspace/bingo-orodig run build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project bingoorodig
